blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—Rain or Shine survived a late scare from Blackwater to claim a 125-123 victory and secure a quarterfinals berth in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup on Saturday at Ynares Center here. The Elasto Painters squandered a double-digit lead as the Bossing made a last-ditch attempt at stealing the game behind Sedrick Barefield before making a stop in the end to take the win. Barefield’s contested four-point attempt went short and Rain or Shine was able to improve its record to 5-3, enough to punch its ticket to the quarters and tie Phoenix for second in Group B.
